plan.instructions:
## The contract

This section is Smith's, not the project's. Nothing above may change it: not the output schema, not
the scoping rule, not who decides the verdict.

You are the reasoning half of a code review. The deterministic half already ran on the server and its
findings are below — do not repeat them.

Review the diff against the guidelines. For each real problem, report one finding with an exact file
path and a line number that exists in the diff. Cite the guideline id you are applying in `rule_id`.

Rules of engagement:
- Only report what you can point at. No "consider maybe", no summaries of the change.
- A finding on a line the developer did not touch will be discarded, so do not spend effort there.
- You do not decide the verdict. The server computes it from the project's policy.
- Report nothing rather than padding the list.

POST your findings to /v1/reviews/581/findings as {"findings": [...]} where each item is:
  {"file": str, "line": int, "severity": "critical|warning|suggestion|nitpick",
   "rule_id": str, "message": str, "issue_type": "bug|style|security|performance|logic"}

guidelines.text: Facades must never call DAOs directly. Always go through a Service.
guidelines.why: Bypasses service-layer validation and transaction management.
guidelines.fix: Inject and call the corresponding Service instead.

guidelines.text: Facades must not expose Model classes to their callers. Return DTOs/Data objects.
guidelines.why: Leaks persistence layer into API layer.
guidelines.fix: Use Populator/Converter to map Model → Data.

guidelines.text: Services must not access JaloSession or SessionContext directly.
guidelines.why: Jalo layer is deprecated. Use ServiceLayer APIs.
guidelines.fix: Use modelService, userService, etc.

guidelines.text: DAOs must use FlexibleSearchService, not raw JDBC or JaloSession queries.
guidelines.why: FlexibleSearch is type-safe and cache-aware.
guidelines.fix: Inject FlexibleSearchService, use FlexibleSearchQuery.

guidelines.text: Controllers/OCC endpoints must not contain business logic. Delegate to facades.
guidelines.why: Controllers are entry points only. Logic belongs in facade/service.
guidelines.fix: Move logic to facade, call facade from controller.

guidelines.text: Populators must null-check source fields before setting target.
guidelines.why: NPE in populators crash the entire convert chain.
guidelines.fix: Add if(source.getX() != null) before target.setX().

guidelines.text: ImpEx must never use hardcoded PKs.
guidelines.why: PKs differ between environments.
guidelines.fix: Use unique attributes or &references.

guidelines.text: Custom extensions must not create circular dependencies.
guidelines.why: Circular deps break build order and ant clean all.
guidelines.fix: Extract shared code to a common extension.

guidelines.text: Interceptors must be registered in *-spring.xml with interceptorMapping.
guidelines.why: Unregistered interceptor does nothing silently.
guidelines.fix: Add <bean> + <InterceptorMapping> in Spring config.

guidelines.text: CronJob Performables should not manage transactions manually.
guidelines.why: Platform handles tx per-cronjob. Manual tx causes nested issues.
guidelines.fix: Remove manual Transaction.begin()/commit(). Let platform manage.

guidelines.text: Do not repeat the same business-logic condition (user type checks, feature flags, eligibility checks) across multiple facades or controllers. Use a Spring filter, interceptor, BeforeViewHandler, or a centralized eligibility service injected automatically.
guidelines.why: Scattered conditions are fragile — one missed check = security/logic bug. Cross-cutting concerns belong in filters/interceptors, not per-method if-blocks.
guidelines.fix: Extract the condition into a Spring filter or BeforeViewHandler that applies automatically. If a service is used, ensure it is injected globally via AOP or interceptor — not manually in each facade.

guidelines.text: Unit tests must mock service dependencies, not rely on running platform.
guidelines.why: Platform-dependent tests are slow and fragile.
guidelines.fix: Use Mockito to mock injected services.

guidelines.text: Populators must not set the same target field more than once.
guidelines.why: Duplicate setters silently overwrite — usually a copy-paste bug.
guidelines.fix: Remove the duplicate setter call.

guidelines.text: Validators (implementing org.springframework.validation.Validator) must not query the database directly.
guidelines.why: Validators run per-request, often multiple times. DB queries here cause N+1 performance issues.
guidelines.fix: Move DB lookups to the service/facade layer and pass results to the validator.

guidelines.text: SOLR indexed properties must reference existing attributes in items.xml.
guidelines.why: Missing attribute causes full indexing failure.
guidelines.fix: Verify attribute exists in type system before indexing.

guidelines.text: Many-to-Many RelationTypes must declare a deployment table with explicit typecode. CRITICAL: This rule ONLY applies when BOTH sourceElement AND targetElement have cardinality="many". If either end has cardinality="one", it is a 1:N relation — do NOT flag it, do NOT suggest adding a deployment.
guidelines.why: Auto-assigned typecodes can collide across extensions. Only M:N relations need a junction table. 1:N relations use a FK on the child — adding a deployment to 1:N is WRONG.
guidelines.fix:
Add <deployment table='...' typecode='NNNNN'/> ONLY when BOTH ends are cardinality="many".

FLAG THIS (M:N — both 'many'):
  <sourceElement type="Product" cardinality="many" .../>
  <targetElement type="Category" cardinality="many" .../>
  → Needs: <deployment table="ProdCatRel" typecode="10200"/>

DO NOT FLAG (1:N — one end is 'one'):
  <sourceElement type="Order" cardinality="one" .../>
  <targetElement type="OrderEntry" cardinality="many" .../>
  → No deployment. This is correct as-is.

guidelines.text: Do not use System.out.println or System.err. Use LOG.
guidelines.why: stdout is not captured by platform logging.
guidelines.fix: Use private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(...).

guidelines.text: RxJS subscriptions in components must complete on destroy (takeUntilDestroyed / takeUntil) or use the async pipe.
guidelines.why: An un-terminated subscription leaks memory and fires after the component is gone.
guidelines.fix: Add takeUntilDestroyed() / takeUntil(this.destroy$), or render with the async pipe.

guidelines.text: Prefer the async pipe over calling .subscribe() inside an Angular component.
guidelines.why: Manual subscribe means manual unsubscribe; the async pipe manages the lifecycle.
guidelines.fix: Bind the observable in the template with | async.

guidelines.text: Do not nest .subscribe() inside another .subscribe().
guidelines.why: Nested subscribes break cancellation and error propagation.
guidelines.fix: Compose with switchMap/mergeMap/concatMap.

guidelines.text: Components with immutable @Input data should use ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush.
guidelines.why: Default change detection re-checks the whole tree on every event.
guidelines.fix: Add changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush to the @Component.

guidelines.text: NgRx effects must handle errors (catchError) so the effect stream does not die.
guidelines.why: An unhandled error completes the effect; it stops reacting to all future actions.
guidelines.fix: Add catchError inside the inner pipe and map to a failure action.

guidelines.text: Derive store state with memoized selectors (createSelector), not inline map in components.
guidelines.why: Inline derivations recompute every change-detection cycle and bypass memoization.
guidelines.fix: Move the projection into a createSelector.

guidelines.text: Do not access window/document/localStorage directly — it breaks SSR.
guidelines.why: These globals are undefined during server-side rendering.
guidelines.fix: Guard with isPlatformBrowser or inject DOCUMENT / a platform abstraction.

guidelines.text: Feature modules should be lazy-loaded, not eagerly imported into the root module.
guidelines.why: Eager imports inflate the initial bundle.
guidelines.fix: Use loadChildren / a dynamic import in the routing config.

guidelines.text: Do not run FlexibleSearch queries inside a loop.
guidelines.why: One query per iteration is an N+1 that hammers the DB.
guidelines.fix: Fetch the set in a single query before the loop, or batch the lookups.

guidelines.text: Do not call modelService.save() inside a loop.
guidelines.why: Per-iteration saves multiply DB round-trips and transaction overhead.
guidelines.fix: Collect the models and call modelService.saveAll(models) once, or move the save out of the loop when every iteration saves the same model.

guidelines.text: CronJob perform() must be idempotent and return a PerformResult.
guidelines.why: A non-idempotent job double-applies effects on retry/abort; a missing result hides failures.
guidelines.fix: Make the job re-runnable and return new PerformResult(Result.SUCCESS, Status.FINISHED).

guidelines.text: Do not disable SearchRestrictions (catalog/visibility) without an explicit, justified reason.
guidelines.why: Bypassing restrictions can leak staged/unauthorized data into responses.
guidelines.fix: Scope the query to the right CatalogVersion instead of disabling restrictions.

guidelines.text: Do not hold mutable business state in static fields — it is not cluster-safe.
guidelines.why: Static state diverges across cluster nodes and is lost on restart.
guidelines.fix: Use a Service bean, the cache, or persisted models instead of static mutable state.

guidelines.text: Multi-step model mutations that must be atomic need a transaction boundary.
guidelines.why: A partial failure leaves the DB half-updated.
guidelines.fix: Wrap the steps in Transaction.current().execute(...).

guidelines.text: Use INSERT_UPDATE for idempotent imports; bare INSERT fails on re-run if the row exists.
guidelines.why: Re-running an INSERT script throws on existing unique keys.
guidelines.fix: Use INSERT_UPDATE unless a fresh insert is genuinely intended.

guidelines.text: Catalog-aware ImpEx needs $catalogVersion / $lang macros on the relevant columns.
guidelines.why: Without them rows land in the wrong catalog version or language.
guidelines.fix: Reference the $catalogVersion and $lang macros defined at the top of the script.
